missing_values.definition: Orders (except optional promotion_id) or Order_Items rows with any blank field

duplicate_orders.definition: Orders repeating an order_id or all non-key fields

duplicate_order_lines.definition: Order_Items repeating an order_item_id or all non-key fields

invalid_menu_prices.definition: Prices <= 0 or > 50x the table median (menu, order lines, pricing history)

invalid_dates.definition: Blank, future or pre-2000 dates in Orders, Ratings and Wastage

invalid_ratings.definition: Non-blank rating_value outside the whole numbers 1-5

invalid_restaurant_ids.definition: Orders whose restaurant_id is not in Restaurants

impossible_wastage.definition: Negative wastage, or wastage above the latest prior closing stock for the same item and location

incorrect_discounts.definition: Line discount < 0 or > quantity x unit_price, or order discount > subtotal

inconsistent_units.definition: Inventory/Wastage units that differ from the menu item's unit or are not portion/plate/bowl/glass/piece

invalid_location_references.definition: restaurant_id values not in Restaurants, across Orders, Ratings, Inventory and Wastage
